creator: Alexander Terp
description:
A pane the director had already added to a directed group was refused when it tried to take a name in that group. `muster msg join --group <g> --name prod-tracer` answered "<g>'s policy does not let prod-tracer join it; ... only director or @human may". The director had briefed the member with that line, and the council skill does not say how a member added as a pane should name itself.

## Measured: 2026-10-01, devenv, a directed council

After the refusal, `muster msg join --name prod-tracer` (no group) switched the pane's identity, so `muster msg post --group <g>` then failed: "prod-tracer is not in <g>". The member got through with `post --as <pane>`. Councils convened since work around it: the director starts each member with a first prompt to run `muster msg join --name X`, then adds it to the group by that name, then posts the brief.

## Things that might be true

- **Let an added pane join under a name, the name taking over the pane's membership.**
- Or have the council skill (extras/skill/council/SKILL.md, Convening) tell directors to have members name themselves before `group add`, and add them by name.
- Either way, the refusal could say "you are already a member as <pane>".
title: A pane added to a directed group cannot take a name in it
